items.title: Clem Raymond Interview, 1958-08-25
items.q: He played with Keppard and Oliver.

ctx.x: Oh, I see. I don't know what happened to his royalties now. If we get that.

I don't know. Maybe his sisters are... Anita still has a brother that's up in Portland. In fact, he wrote to me about in June. Oh, I can't remember now his first name. He didn't give me the names. A couple of initials, like R.E. or something. I believe it was. R.E. Johnson. That'd be Robert or something. So, Dink and Bill Johnson is in Texas, I think. He's a bass player, another brother of Anita's. He played with Keppard and Oliver. He played with Oliver a long time. Made records with Joe Oliver in Chicago. And…
I'll go to someone. Yeah. Next, near his relative, I guess.
